lines.en: label sportswars16:
scene clearnightsky
What’s it like to be “special?”
lines.zh: 被称作“特别”是什么感觉？

lines.en: You always told me that’s what I was but, in my eyes, you were the one who fit that bill the best.
lines.zh: 你总说我就是那样的人，可在我的眼里，真正当得起这个词的却是你。

lines.en: I was just me. And you were just you. But you were the first one I loved. So that must count for something, right?
lines.zh: 我就是我。你也就是你。但你是我第一个爱上的人。所以这总该有点分量吧？

lines.en: I wonder what you’d say if you could see me now.
lines.zh: 我想知道，如果你能看到现在的我，会说些什么。

lines.en: I wonder if you’d still call me special.
lines.zh: 我想知道，你还会不会说我特别。

lines.en: Or if I’ve become so forgettable that you’d take one look at me before turning around and purging me from your memory.
lines.zh: 又或者，我已经变得如此容易被遗忘，你只看我一眼就会转过身，把我从你的记忆里彻底抹去。

lines.en: There might be other forces at play when it comes to that outcome, sure. I mean, just look at where we are.
lines.zh: 当然，那样的结果背后也许还有别的力量在起作用。我是说，看看我们现在身处何地就知道了。

lines.en: Saying this city is a place that’s grounded in reality would be a bit of a stretch, wouldn’t it? Especially when there are ten or twelve things each day proving the exact opposite.
lines.zh: 说这座城市是个立足于现实的地方，未免有点牵强吧？尤其是每天都有十件、十二件事在证明恰恰相反。

lines.en: But that’s just the problem. This place IS grounded in reality. It’s all of US that make it seem so weird. It’s what WE see — what WE feel.
lines.zh: 可问题恰恰就在这儿。这个地方确实立足于现实。让它显得如此诡异的，是我们所有人。是我们所见——我们所感。

lines.en: And you feel more than anyone.
lines.zh: 而你比任何人都感受得更多。

lines.en: I remember the sound of your heartbeat — how irregular it was. But also how comfortable and calm it made me feel when I’d lie there on your chest.
lines.zh: 我记得你的心跳声——它是那么不规律。可当我躺在你的胸口时，它又让我感到那么安心、那么平静。

lines.en: You felt like an earthquake back then.
lines.zh: 那时候的你感觉就像一场地震。

lines.en: But I was just me. And you were just you.
lines.zh: 可我就是我。你也就是你。

lines.en: And that’s all we ever needed to be, since our home was far more fortunate than the one you find yourself in now.
lines.zh: 而这就是我们一直需要成为的全部，因为我们的家，比你现在身处其中的那个要幸运得多。

lines.en: But, hey...
lines.zh: 不过，嘿……

lines.en: I hope you’re having fun.
lines.zh: 我希望你玩得开心。

lines.en: I know you’re not, but I hope you are.
lines.zh: 我知道你并不开心，但我希望你是。

lines.en: And that’s probably silly of me. But that’s the way I’ve always been.
lines.zh: 也许我这样挺傻的。可我一直都是这样。

lines.en: Your precious little trickster.
lines.zh: 你珍视的小小骗子。

lines.en: Your kick to the shin.
lines.zh: 你踢在胫骨上的那一脚。

lines.en: scene apoxapox1
Your lifejacket.
lines.zh: 你的救生衣。

lines.en: : What the fuck is this place?
lines.zh: : 这他妈是什么地方？

lines.en: : A home away from home.
lines.zh: : 家外之家。

lines.en: : And it’s yours?
lines.zh: : 这是你的？

lines.en: : How long have you had this and why haven’t you told me about it yet? An extra apartment is the solution to like nine-hundred of our problems.
lines.zh: : 你有多久了，为什么一直没告诉我？多一套公寓能解决我们大概九百个问题。

lines.en: : You must have me confused with someone else. I don’t have any problems with you.
lines.zh: : 你一定是把我当成别人了。我跟你之间没有任何问题。

lines.en: scene apoxapox2
: This is our very first meeting. And the only reason I’ve taken you here is because I’m a bad person.
lines.zh: : 这是我们第一次见面。而我带你来这儿的唯一理由，是因为我是个坏人。

lines.en: : Sorry, are we roleplaying now? Who am I supposed to be this time?
lines.zh: : 抱歉，我们现在是在玩角色扮演吗？这次我该演谁？

lines.en: : Someone better at hiding their feelings.
lines.zh: : 一个更擅长隐藏自己感情的人。

lines.en: scene apoxapox3
: Ughhhh. Ayane again?
lines.zh: : 呃啊啊啊。又是 Ayane？

lines.en: scene apoxapox4
: Do you want something to drink?
lines.zh: : 想喝点什么吗？

lines.en: : Oooh, I get a beverage this time? How nice. You weren’t abducted by aliens as well, were you?
lines.zh: : 哦哦，这次还有饮料？真好。你该不会也被外星人绑架了吧？

lines.en: : Do you want something or not?
lines.zh: : 你到底要不要？

lines.en: scene black
: Coffee, please.
lines.zh: : 咖啡，谢谢。

lines.en: : I have a feeling I’ll need the energy.
lines.zh: : 我有预感，我会需要这些精力。

lines.en: scene apoxapox5
: Are you sure you don’t want me to be your partner? Because I swear I’m really good at this game. I’m not just lying about being good at it for clout like Imani.
lines.zh: : 你确定不要我当你的搭档吗？我发誓我真的很擅长这个游戏。我可不是像 Imani 那样为了出风头吹牛说自己在行。

lines.en: : Bitch, I ain’t lyin’ ‘bout shit. Sit yo ass down.
lines.zh: : 婊子，我他妈可一句谎都没撒。给老子坐下。

lines.en: : I am quite positive, Rika. Especially due to the fact that this is a one-on-one competition between Imani and me to decide the winner of the Dorm Wars.
lines.zh: : 我很确定不要，Rika。尤其是因为这本来就是我和 Imani 之间一对一的对决，用来决定宿舍战争的赢家。

lines.en: : So like, how’s that shit work exactly? Ain’t the first floor still up by one after we got the point for that weird fuckin’ leg game?
lines.zh: : 那到底怎么算的啊？我们靠那个奇怪的装腿比赛拿了一分之后，一层不是还领先一分吗？

lines.en: : Technically, yes. But, given that Maya’s been absent for the entire competition and very likely won’t show up in the final hour, you guys are getting one point docked. Which makes the score four to four.
lines.zh: : 理论上是的。不过考虑到 Maya 整场比赛都缺席，而且几乎不可能在最后一小时出现，你们要被扣掉一分。这样比分就变成四比四。

lines.en: : Which, if you have learned anything about math, would indicate that this is a “winner takes all” scenario.
lines.zh: : 而只要你还学过一点数学，就会明白这意味着“赢家通吃”的局面。

lines.en: : I know how fuckin’ numbers work, goth lady.
lines.zh: : 我他妈知道数字怎么算，哥特女。

lines.en: : Congratulations, Yamaguchi. You have detention on Friday as well now.
lines.zh: : 恭喜你，Yamaguchi。这下你周五也要留堂了。

lines.en: scene apoxapox6
: Now, I’m not trying to overstep my boundaries or whatever, but I’m pretty sure you can’t give my students detention for things they do outside of school hours.
lines.zh: : 那个，我可不是想越界什么的，但我很确定你不能因为我的学生在校外做的事情给他们留堂。

lines.en: : Cause, if that were the case, we’d all have detention right now for hanging out at a strip club.
lines.zh: : 因为如果那样也算的话，我们现在全都要因为泡在脱衣舞俱乐部里而留堂了。

lines.en: : My spotless school record is suddenly in danger. I must leave this place at once.
lines.zh: : 我那毫无瑕疵的在校记录突然岌岌可危了。我必须立刻离开这个地方。

lines.en: scene apoxapox7
: “Spotless” my ass — you’ve got a D in biology.
lines.zh: : 毫无瑕疵个屁——你生物可是 D。

lines.en: : I will never understand the purpose of gonads no matter how many times it is explained to me.
lines.zh: : 不管给我解释多少遍，我都永远不会明白性腺到底有什么用。

lines.en: : Imani, just throw the fucking ball already.
lines.zh: : Imani，赶紧他妈扔球吧。

lines.en: scene apoxapox8
: Bitch, let me aim!
lines.zh: : 婊子，让我瞄准！

lines.en: : Rin! After Wakana and Imani are done playing beer pong, do you and your friends want to play?! Because I do! And I don’t have other friends so I need to borrow yours!
lines.zh: : Rin！等 Wakana 和 Imani 打完啤酒乒乓，你和你的朋友们要不要来玩？！因为我想玩！而且我没有别的朋友，所以得借你的！

lines.en: : Please don’t get your daughter drunk in the presence of school teachers, Rika.
lines.zh: : 请不要在学校老师面前把你女儿灌醉，Rika。

lines.en: : I’m 42, Wakana. I can do whatever I want.
lines.zh: : 我 42 了，Wakana。我想干什么就干什么。

lines.en: : You certainly can n-
lines.zh: : 你当然可以——

lines.en: scene apoxapox9
: Ha!
scene apoxapox10
: Fuck yeah!
lines.zh: : 操，好！

lines.en: : Oh, nice job. But why was the splash sound so violently realistic?
lines.zh: : 哦，漂亮。不过那水花声为什么逼真得这么暴力？

lines.en: : That’s just how I roll, girl. Beat that, Wakana.
lines.zh: : 我就是这么玩的，妹子。来超过我啊，Wakana。

lines.en: scene apoxapox11
: That was luck and you know it. We’ve played this game at least twenty times at the bar and not once have you sunk anything on your first shot.
lines.zh: : 那就是运气，你心里清楚。我们在酒吧玩过至少二十次，你一次都没在第一球就命中过。

lines.en: : Yeah, but I’ve never had the fate of the second floor in my hands before. I am being empowered by my responsibility and love for ten very strange girls! Several of whom are currently absent.
lines.zh: : 是，可我以前从来没有把二层的命运握在手里过。我对十个非常奇怪的女孩的责任和爱给了我力量！其中好几个现在还不在场。

lines.en: : Ain’t you supposed to be responsible for all of us as our teacher and shit? Not just the second floor?
lines.zh: : 你作为我们的老师什么的，不该对我们所有人都负责吗？不只是二层吧？

lines.en: : The rest of you are my responsibility for now. Then, after tonight, I can go back to not caring about anything that happens to any of you who aren’t named Miyamura.
lines.zh: : 今晚之前，你们其他人暂时还是我的责任。过了今晚，我就可以重新回去对你们中不姓 Miyamura 的人发生的一切都不闻不问了。

lines.en: scene apoxapox12
: Huh? What? I heard my name.
lines.zh: : 哈？什么？我听到我的名字了。

lines.en: : Miyamura- retrieve that ball from that cup. I’d do it myself, but I’m too old and frail and would likely hurt myself in the process.
lines.zh: : Miyamura——把那个杯子里的球捞出来。我自己来也行，可我太老了、太虚弱了，过程中大概会伤到自己。

lines.en: : Wakana, you’re more than capable of getting it yourself. You can’t blame everything on your back and shouldn’t be making Makoto do your bidding.
lines.zh: : Wakana，你自己完全拿得到。你不能什么都怪到你的背上，也不该让 Makoto 替你跑腿。

lines.en: : Old? Aren’t you in your 20’s?
lines.zh: : 老？你不是才二十多岁吗？

lines.en: : Yes. But you’ll soon find that means nothing in the face of aging’s terrible effects on the human body. Then, next thing you know, you won’t even have the motivation to go to the gym anymore.
lines.zh: : 是啊。但你会发现，在衰老对人体可怕的影响面前，这根本不算什么。然后一转眼，你连去健身房的劲头都没有了。

lines.en: : Speak for yourself. I still go every day.
lines.zh: : 那是你自己。我每天都还去呢。

lines.en: : I’ve never even set foot in a gym. But sure, I’ll get your ball if it brings us closer to winning the competition.
lines.zh: : 我连健身房都没踏进去过。不过行吧，如果这能让我们更接近赢得比赛，我就去帮你捡球。

lines.en: scene apoxapox13
: Disqualification! Makoto touched the ball! This means Wakana’s enlisted a partner and has broken the rules of one-on-one beer pong!
lines.zh: : 取消资格！Makoto 碰到球了！这意味着 Wakana 找了个搭档，违反了一对一啤酒乒乓的规则！

lines.en: : As official referee, I declare that no rules have been broken and that anyone can touch any balls they want!
lines.zh: : 作为正式裁判，我宣布没有任何规则被打破，任何人都随便碰任何球！

lines.en: : What wonderful news, Osako. I’ve gotten the green light from Rika as well. I’m just one Tinder profile away from heterosexuality now, aren’t I?
lines.zh: : 真是个好消息，Osako。Rika 那边也给我开了绿灯。现在我离异性恋只差一个 Tinder 账号了，是吧？

lines.en: : Not now, Wakana...not here.
lines.zh: : 现在不行，Wakana……别在这儿。

lines.en: : I’m glad everyone seems to be having fun again. Between Yasu collapsing and the end of the Newly-Newlywed Game, things got pretty intense for a little, didn’t they?
lines.zh: : 很高兴大家看起来又玩得开心了。从 Yasu 晕倒到新新婚游戏收场，气氛有一阵子挺紧张的，是吧？

lines.en: : Yes, but...at least we wound up winning the...leg thing. A second tragic loss might make me believe we’re not really as close as we think.
lines.zh: : 是啊，不过……至少我们最后赢下了那个……装腿的比赛。要是再惨败一次，我大概会开始怀疑我们其实没有自己以为的那么亲近。

lines.en: scene apoxapox14
: What do you mean? Of course we are! No silly competition could ever get in the way of our friendship.
lines.zh: : 你什么意思？我们当然亲近！再蠢的比赛也不可能挡在我们友谊中间。

lines.en: : You...really think we’re that indestructible?
lines.zh: : 你……真觉得我们牢不可破到那种程度？

lines.en: : Do you not? Is my undying love for you unrequited?
lines.zh: : 你不这么觉得吗？我对你的爱至死不渝，难道是没有回应的？

lines.en: : No, I just...mean there’s gotta be something that could cause a rift in our friendship, right?
lines.zh: : 不是，我只是……我是说总该有什么东西能在我们的友谊里撕出一道裂缝吧？

lines.en: : Just look at Miss Watabe and her girlfriend. If even they’re fighting right now, there’s probably no relationship strong enough to survive everything...right?
lines.zh: : 看看 Watabe 老师和她女朋友。如果连她们现在都在吵架，大概就没有哪种关系坚固到能扛过一切……对吧？

lines.en: scene apoxapox15
: You think they’re fighting?
lines.zh: : 你觉得她们在吵架？

lines.en: : Is that...not what all of the tension we’ve been seeing ever since she showed up means?...
lines.zh: : 那……我们从她出现之后一直感觉到的那股紧张，难道不是这个意思吗？……

lines.en: : The tension seems pretty one-sided, I think. Maybe they’re just horny?
lines.zh: : 我觉得那股紧张挺单方面的。也许她们只是发情了？

lines.en: scene apoxapox16
: Yeah...maybe.
lines.zh: : 嗯……也许吧。

lines.en: : Is everything okay, Sana? You’ve seemed kind of weird for a little while now.
lines.zh: : Sana，你还好吗？你这阵子看起来有点怪怪的。

lines.en: : Do you think...
lines.zh: : 你觉得……

lines.en: : Just...out of curiosity...do you think that stuff Nodoka said about Io had any truth to it?...
lines.zh: : 只是……出于好奇……你觉得 Nodoka 说的那些关于 Io 的话，有几分是真的吗？……

lines.en: : That she was...you know...
lines.zh: : 就是她……你知道的……

lines.en: scene apoxapox17
: Hah...
: I don’t know, but...I hope not.
lines.zh: : 我不知道，不过……我希望不是。

lines.en: : I’m trying to forget about it since it feels like a complete invasion of privacy, but...it would definitely explain some things.
lines.zh: : 我试着不去想它，因为那感觉完全是在侵犯隐私，不过……它确实能解释一些事情。

lines.en: : And Nodoka was right about all of that other stuff, so...
lines.zh: : 而且 Nodoka 其他那些都说对了，所以……

lines.en: : Nodoka’s...kind of a really bad person if she’d just...say that in front of everybody, isn’t she?...
lines.zh: : Nodoka……如果她就这么当着所有人的面说出那种话，她是不是算是挺糟糕的人？……

lines.en: : Yeah...
: It really makes you wonder if there was more to that stuff with Yumi in the classroom from a while ago.
lines.zh: : 这真让人忍不住想，前阵子在教室里和 Yumi 发生的那件事，是不是还有什么隐情。

lines.en: : Like, what if she really did do something to provoke her and just...none of us knew about it?
lines.zh: : 比如说，要是她真的做了什么去招惹她，而只是……我们谁都不知道呢？

lines.en: : It’s not really...like we can ask Yumi either since none of us talk to her.
lines.zh: : 反正我们也……问不了 Yumi，毕竟我们没人和她说话。

lines.en: : I think she just wants to be left alone for the most part. But hey, she’s been fitting in a little better lately and...that’s good, I guess.
lines.zh: : 我觉得她多半只是想一个人待着。不过嘿，她最近融入得好一点了，而且……我想这是好事。

lines.en: : Yeah...fitting in is...hard enough as is...
lines.zh: : 是啊……光是融入就已经……够难的了……

lines.en: scene apoxapox18
: You’ve been doing well, though. But despite your sudden up-tick in conversations with others, I think the thing I’m most excited about is the fact that I get to see both of your eyes every day now.
lines.zh: : 不过你做得很好。而且尽管你和别人的交流突然多了起来，我觉得最让我高兴的是——现在每天都能看到你的两只眼睛了。

lines.en: : Are you...flirting with me?
lines.zh: : 你……是在跟我调情吗？

lines.en: : I can think you’re cute without flirting, you know. You’re like a doll.
lines.zh: : 我可以觉得你可爱但并不是在调情，你知道的。你像个洋娃娃。

lines.en: : And besides, I like boys. One boy, to be specific. Well...one man. But you get the point.
lines.zh: : 再说了，我喜欢男的。具体来说是一个男孩。嗯……一个男人。你懂我意思。

lines.en: : Yeah...I get the point.
lines.zh: : 嗯……我懂。

lines.en: : How about you, though?
lines.zh: : 那你呢？

lines.en: : What do you mean?
lines.zh: : 你什么意思？

lines.en: scene apoxapox19
: Well, my child — without beating around the bush, I’ve been noticing some changes in you lately. And you are at the age now, so I don’t hold it against you.
lines.zh: : 嗯，我的孩子——我就直说了，最近我注意到你有些变化。而你也到了这个年纪了，所以我不会因此责怪你。

lines.en: scene apoxapox20
: But I don’t think I’ve ever really asked you how you felt about girls on a...sexual level.
lines.zh: : 不过我想我从来没有真正问过你，在……性的层面上，你对女孩是什么感觉。

lines.en: : You don’t have to tell me if you don’t want to. But you should know that my opinion of you won’t change no matter how you answer.
lines.zh: : 你不想说可以不说。但你应该知道，不管你怎么回答，我对你的看法都不会变。

lines.en: scene apoxapox21
: I don’t...
lines.zh: : 我不……

lines.en: : I don’t really...know how I feel, but...
lines.zh: : 我不太……清楚自己的感觉，不过……

lines.en: : I think...
lines.zh: : 我觉得……

lines.en: : I think I do...like them like that...
lines.zh: : 我觉得我……确实是以那种方式喜欢她们……

lines.en: scene apoxapox22
: But I like boys too.
lines.zh: : 但我也喜欢男孩子。

lines.en: : Then you’ll fit right in with the rest of the class. Like half of us are bi at this point. And hey, that gives you a bunch of options as well.
lines.zh: : 那你正好和班上的其他人打成一片。这会儿我们大概有一半是双性恋。而且嘿，这也给了你一大堆选择。

lines.en: : Ayane...
lines.zh: : Ayane……

lines.en: : Is there anyone in particular who catches your eye? Anyone who interests you?
lines.zh: : 有哪个特别的人吸引你的目光吗？有谁让你感兴趣吗？

lines.en: : Ayane...there’s...I...
lines.zh: : Ayane……有……我……

lines.en: : Maybe Rin? You two have kissed already.
lines.zh: : 也许是 Rin？你们俩已经亲过了。

lines.en: : Did you like it? How did it make you feel?
lines.zh: : 你喜欢吗？那让你感觉怎么样？

lines.en: : Ayane, I like Sensei.
lines.zh: : Ayane，我喜欢 Sensei。

lines.en: scene apoxapox23
: Like...a lot.
lines.zh: : 是……非常喜欢。

lines.en: : I’m sorry I didn’t tell you sooner. I just...
lines.zh: : 抱歉我没有早点告诉你。我只是……

lines.en: : You’ve liked him for so long and...
lines.zh: : 你喜欢他那么久了，然后……

lines.en: scene apoxapox24
: I didn’t want this to happen.
lines.zh: : 我不想让这种事发生的。

lines.en: : I tried so hard to avoid it...for so long...but he just...
lines.zh: : 我一直拼命地躲，躲了那么久……可他就是……

lines.en: : He kept coming...
lines.zh: : 他一直来……

lines.en: : He kept looking at me...
lines.zh: : 他一直看着我……

lines.en: : And somewhere along the line, I stopped wanting to get away and...
lines.zh: : 然后不知道从什么时候开始，我不再想逃了，而是……

lines.en: scene apoxapox25
: And wanting to be with him instead.
lines.zh: : 而是想和他在一起。

lines.en: : Ayane, I’m really sorry.
lines.zh: : Ayane，我真的很抱歉。

lines.en: : Why are you apologizing? I’ve known this even longer than you have.
lines.zh: : 你道什么歉？我知道这件事的时间比你还长呢。

lines.en: : Because...because I wasn’t...I wasn’t supposed to get in the way. I don’t want to get in the way. Of your happiness, I mean.
lines.zh: : 因为……因为我不该……我不该挡在路上。我不想挡路。我是说，挡住你的幸福。

lines.en: : Sana, you’re not my only friend with a crush on the same man as me. And, as I’m sure you’ve noticed, pretty much every single girl in our class feels the same way as you. This changes nothing.
lines.zh: : Sana，你又不是我唯一一个和我喜欢上同一个男人的朋友。而且我相信你也注意到了，我们班上几乎每一个女生都和你一样。这改变不了什么。

lines.en: : But it might.
lines.zh: : 但也许会。

lines.en: : It won’t.
lines.zh: : 不会的。

lines.en: : But...I’m not going to hold back, you know.
lines.zh: : 不过……我不会手下留情的，你知道。

lines.en: : I wouldn’t expect you to. Nothing’s ever easy when it comes to love.
lines.zh: : 我也没指望你会。爱情这回事，从来就没有容易过。

lines.en: : You can do whatever you want. I’m still going to win in the end.
lines.zh: : 你想怎么做都行。最后赢的人还是会是我。

lines.en: : You sound...pretty confident about that.
lines.zh: : 你听起来……对此相当自信啊。

lines.en: : I’ve told you before — confidence is what makes a girl attractive.
lines.zh: : 我跟你说过——自信才让一个女孩有魅力。

lines.en: scene apoxapox26
: But I’m sure I don’t need to tell you what it is that makes a girl attractive now that you’re finally figuring out who you are.
lines.zh: : 不过既然你终于在搞清楚自己是谁了，我相信不需要我告诉你，是什么让一个女孩有魅力。

lines.en: : I’m really proud of you, Sana.
lines.zh: : 我真的为你骄傲，Sana。

lines.en: : You’ve come such a long way.
lines.zh: : 你已经走了这么远。

lines.en: : And to think that, to you...it’s probably only been a few months.
lines.zh: : 想想看，对你来说……大概才过了几个月而已。

lines.en: : Ayane...
lines.zh: : Ayane……

lines.en: : Whatever happens, I want you to follow your heart.
lines.zh: : 不管发生什么，我希望你遵从自己的心。

lines.en: : I’ll love you no matter what.
lines.zh: : 不管怎样我都会爱你。

lines.en: scene apoxapox27
: There’s...
lines.zh: : 还有……

lines.en: : There’s something else I should tell you too...
lines.zh: : 还有一件事我也该告诉你……

lines.en: scene apoxapox28
: Both sides have one cup remaining! The next person to sink a shot wins!
lines.zh: : 双方都只剩一个杯子了！下一个投中的人获胜！

lines.en: : Yes. Thank you, referee. I have never played this game before and do not have eyes, so there is no way I could have possibly known any of that.
lines.zh: : 是啊。谢谢你，裁判。我从来没玩过这个游戏，也没有眼睛，所以我绝不可能知道这些。

lines.en: : Think for a second, Wakana. Do you really want to make this shot?
lines.zh: : 想一下，Wakana。你真的想投进这一球吗？

lines.en: : Because we’ve got several transfers from your class on the second floor. And me winning means they win. Which is kind of like you winning in a way, right?
lines.zh: : 因为我们二层那边有几个从你班上转过来的学生。我赢了就等于她们赢了。某种意义上也算是你赢了，对吧？

lines.en: : Do you know what else is also like “me winning?” Me. Winning.
lines.zh: : 你知道还有什么也像“我赢”吗？我。赢。

lines.en: scene apoxapox29
: Fly!
lines.zh: : 飞吧！

lines.en: scene apoxapox30
scene apoxapox31
scene apoxapox32
scene apoxapox33
: Oh, fuck yeah!
lines.zh: : 哦，操，好！

lines.en: : Prepare to meet your manufacturer.
lines.zh: : 准备去见你的制造商吧。

lines.en: : Shit!
: So close, yet so far! Could this be the most exciting, nail-biting event in sports history?! I think so, folks!
lines.zh: : 就差一点，却又那么远！这会不会是体育史上最激动人心、最扣人心弦的时刻？！各位，我觉得是！

lines.en: : Death ball was literally like three hours ago.
lines.zh: : 死亡球可是才三小时前的事。

lines.en: scene apoxapox34
: Any last words, Wakana?
lines.zh: : 有什么遗言吗，Wakana？

lines.en: scene apoxapox35
: Yes. Please miss.
lines.zh: : 有。请投不中吧。

lines.en: : Never!
lines.zh: : 休想！

lines.en: scene apoxapox36
: Tch!
: Welp.
: FLOOR TWOOOOO! LET’S FUCKING GOOOOOO!
lines.zh: : 二——层——！冲他妈的！！！

lines.en: scene black
: Double or nothing!
lines.zh: : 加倍或全无！

lines.en: : Double what? Cause we ain’t playin’ for cash and losing the point I just got would mean the first floor takes the whole ass competition.
lines.zh: : 加倍什么？我们打的又不是钱，而且输掉我刚拿到的那一分，就意味着一层把整场比赛都拿走了。

lines.en: : Then we’ll play for cash.
lines.zh: : 那就打钱。

lines.en: : Osako, my purse.
lines.zh: : Osako，我的包。

lines.en: : I want in this time! Rin! Let’s take everything Wakana’s got and force her and Osako out onto the street!
lines.zh: : 这次我也要加入！Rin！我们把 Wakana 的一切都赢过来，把她和 Osako 赶到街上去！

lines.en: : Bruh, we ain’t got that much time left. We’ve gotta start cleaning this place up or the strippers will realize we threw a party here.
lines.zh: : 兄弟，我们没那么多时间了。得开始收拾了，不然脱衣舞娘会发现我们在这儿开了个派对。

lines.en: : They don’t know we’re here?!
lines.zh: : 她们不知道我们在这儿？！

lines.en: : Hell nah! You really think they’d rent this place out for a high school party? There ain’t nothin’ legal about this.
lines.zh: : 当然不知道！你真以为她们会把这地方租给高中生开派对？这事可一点都不合法。

lines.en: : Rin! Change of plans! Get the car! We’ve gotta bail! I can’t afford to get arrested again!
lines.zh: : Rin！计划有变！去开车！我们得撤了！我可不能再被抓一次！

lines.en: : What car?!
lines.zh: : 什么车？！

lines.en: : Yours!
lines.zh: : 你的！

lines.en: : I don’t have a- wait, did you steal my neighbor’s car?!
lines.zh: : 我没有——等等，你偷了我邻居的车？！
